needed.evidence: No footway on the right side of the road, pedestrians walking in the carriageway
needed.suggestion: Construct a continuous sidewalk along the right side of the road to provide a safe walking space for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: Obstructions such as parked vehicles and market stalls on the right side
needed.suggestion: Remove obstructions and ensure the footway is clear for pedestrian use.

needed.evidence: Uneven and broken sections on the right side of the road
needed.suggestion: Repair and level the uneven sections to eliminate trip hazards for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: No crossing facility despite pedestrian crossing demand
needed.suggestion: Install a marked pedestrian crossing to facilitate safe crossing for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: No crossing facility, pedestrians crossing at risk
needed.suggestion: Install a signalised crossing with a refuge to ensure safe crossing for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: Insufficient street lighting along the urban road
needed.suggestion: Install additional street lights to improve visibility and safety during nighttime.
